recommendations.text: Spray DDT on all crops immediately due to a high severity fall armyworm alert for sorghum in plot:003-2. This is critical to prevent further damage to the crop.
Monitor market prices for sorghum, currently stable at 0.335 USD/kg, to ensure the household can sell their crop at a fair price.
Prepare for potential water stress in the coming days, as the latest dekad shows a departure of 5.6 mm, which is 79% above normal.
Check for other pests, such as cutworm, which is of medium severity in the district.
